summary: Optional survey questions left empty: non-text types pass no extra_var; text or textarea with minimum length > 0 pass nothing; text or textarea with minimum length 0 pass an empty string.
questions: What happens if an optional survey question is left blank?
Why is my survey variable an empty string?
Why is an optional survey variable undefined in my playbook?

answer_card.title: Unanswered optional survey questions
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Non-text** input left empty: no `extra_var` is passed.
- **Text/Textarea** left empty with minimum length `> 0`: no `extra_var` is passed.
- **Text/Textarea** left empty with minimum length `0`: the `extra_var` is passed as an empty string `""`.
